features.title: Manage Product Records; As a Retail Store Manager, I want to manage product records so that product information can be maintained in the system; Inventory Record Management Capability (+98 more)

openQuestions.text: Are Retail Store Manager, Product Administrator, and Authorized Operator distinct runtime roles, aliases, or story-level labels for the same approved access group?
How do these named actors map to the source-aligned allowlist stories that restrict approved user groups to store employees and customers?
Are retrieval permissions broader than create/update permissions, and if so, what exact role mapping applies?
What exact API endpoints, methods, and payload schemas should be used for product list, detail, create, update, delete, and ownership reference retrieval?
What exact SKU format rule should be enforced?
What exact maximum character limit applies to Description?
Which specific category values are allowed beyond the sample data examples, and are categories fixed reference data or free-form?
Should Product ID uniqueness be enforced, and if so, what duplicate behavior/message is required?
For the product list, should the implementation use pagination or infinite list pattern?
If pagination is used, what are the default page size and sorting rules?
What specific search fields should the list search input query against?
Is the optional “status/filter if useful” actually required, and if so, what product statuses exist?
Should successful edit always route to product detail, or may it return to refreshed list depending on entry point? The source permits both.
What exact audit metadata must be recorded on delete beyond general “audit metadata”?
Is correlation ID always available, or only in some environments/operations?
What is the authoritative source/documentation that determines whether PRODUCTLOCATION is applicable to the product domain?
What exact data should appear in the “API retrieval/read-only reference panel” on the ownership and scope reference page?
Which users beyond Retail Store Manager are considered “authorized users” for read and write actions?
Are read permissions and write permissions the same for product records and the ownership reference page?
What are the required behaviors for session timeout, logout, and re-authentication?
What are the numeric performance targets referenced by “responsiveness under typical load scenarios”?
What retry behavior, if any, should be supported for transient server errors?
Are soft-delete, recovery, or legal retention requirements intentionally excluded, or is delete expected to be hard delete with only audit trace retained?
What exact source timestamp semantics are required for audit trail: application time, database time, or originating request time?
What sorting default should be used on the list page, such as Last Modified descending?
Should price currency be configurable, or is there a fixed currency for all products?
